Device ID & Official Driver Finder

This does not scan the PC. It displays VID/PID and product name only for devices approved in the browser picker, plus a manufacturer name for USB when available. Protected devices may not appear.

Browser GPU fields may be partial. They do not establish an exact PCI ID, installed driver version, or inventory of all GPUs.

In Windows Device Manager, open device Properties → Details → Hardware IDs. Copy one PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_1234 or USB\VID_2341&PID_0043 ID. An instance path, which may contain a serial number, is unnecessary.

Processed in the browser

Selected or entered IDs are processed in this tab. Serial numbers are not read, devices are not opened, and IDs are not stored or sent. Manufacturer links open the corresponding website.

These are vendor-level support links. Check the model, OS and subsystem ID, then follow the vendor or PC maker instructions. An ID match does not establish driver compatibility or authenticity.
